verdict.rationale: E2B runs agent code in isolated Firecracker microVMs in the cloud rather than on the user's machine or server. Host secrets and credentials are therefore structurally out of reach of the code it executes, and outbound network allow/deny controls further limit exfiltration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of secret/credential handling (e.g., guidance on keeping API keys out of sandbox env vars or templates, or credential-proxy patterns), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation guarantees.
